ticket_urgency.description: Score the true urgency of a ticket from its impact, not its tone.
ticket_urgency.use_case: Ordinal scoring - prioritization queues and SLA assignment

question.instructions: Rate how urgent this ticket is, judging by real impact rather than the writer's tone.
criteria: Low: no impact on work; feedback, cosmetic issue or nice-to-have.
Normal: minor issue with an easy workaround.
High: an important feature is broken for a user or team, with no good workaround.
Critical: outage, data loss, security incident, or many users blocked.
